facts.text: Proposed tower about 185 m high: five basement levels of parking and plant, a seven-level mixed-use podium (retail, hospitality, parking and commercial), 41 residential levels and two service levels at the apex.
Figure 1 shows Plan L46 with half-floor apartments and a connecting lobby; Figure 2 shows Plan L47 with a full-floor apartment; Figure 4 is a schematic of lifts and stairs (elevation A-A).
The dispute is whether the fire design described in the fire engineering report complies with Clauses C1 to C6 by Verification Method C/VM2.
The PDF is 56 pages with 36 embedded images.
